summary: Verdict: MIXED (25% confidence). René Benko was convicted of insolvency fraud in October 2025 by the Landesgericht Innsbruck and sentenced to two years imprisonment. Nathalie Benko, his wife, was acquitted in the December 2025 trial at the same court and was not convicted alongside him in 2025.

findings.statement: René Benko was convicted of insolvency fraud in October 2025 by the Landesgericht Innsbruck and sentenced to two years imprisonment.
Nathalie Benko, wife of René Benko, was acquitted in the December 2025 trial at the Landesgericht Innsbruck and was not convicted of any criminal offense in 2025.
Nathalie Benko was involved in legal proceedings related to the Signa Holding bankruptcy at the Landesgericht Innsbruck in December 2025.
